title: Merge In Between Linked Lists
summary: Given two linked lists, list1 of size n and list2 of size m, remove nodes from the a-th to the b-th positions in list1 and insert list2 in their place.
statement: Given two linked lists, list1 of size n and list2 of size m, remove nodes from the a-th to the b-th positions in list1 and insert list2 in their place. Return the head of the modified list.
constraints: 0 < a <= b < len(list1)-1 and list2 is nonempty.
Remove list1 indices a through b inclusive and splice list2 in their place.
reference_solution:
def merge_between_linked_lists(list1,a,b,list2):
    before=list1
    for _ in range(a-1):before=before.next
    after=before
    for _ in range(b-a+2):after=after.next
    before.next=list2;tail=list2
    while tail.next:tail=tail.next
    tail.next=after
    return list1
